up: Retrieve activity data for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2163176 (Lysine-specific demethylase 5C). Filter for IC50 measurements with an exact standard relation ('=') and non-null pChEMBL values. Return exactly these columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID, then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", a.standard_type AS "standard type", a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163176' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
